# Nubols

> Nubols gives AI agents persistent Linux workspaces to run tools, install software, deploy services, and respond to hooks. Users can work by chat or take control through the terminal.

Nubols is the cloud product. Nebula is the underlying agent runtime. An agent is a runtime configuration; a workspace is its persistent computing environment. Consult the documentation and current plans for supported features and limits.

## Public resources

- [Documentation](https://nubols.com/docs): Getting started and runtime concepts.
- [Capabilities](https://nubols.com/docs?topic=capabilities): Skills, commands, rules, MCP connections, and hooks.
- [Runtime API](https://nubols.com/docs?topic=runtime-api): Runtime interfaces.
- [Security](https://nubols.com/docs?topic=security): Security modes and tool approvals.
- [Plans](https://nubols.com/plans): Current plans and pricing.
- [Legal](https://nubols.com/legal): Privacy, terms, acceptable use, cookies, and security.
- [Contact](https://nubols.com/contact): Support, sales, and security enquiries.
